desc: Phase 0 prep (no git — work in-place): inspect oghuzlands.glb (embedded PNG vs external KTX2, gltfpack -kn -kv -ke string compression); re-export glb without -kn/-kv/-ke (keep -vpf -vn 16 -vtf, no -cc) and verify it loads in Diligent GLTFLoader/Radient with plain-JSON node names (verify current Filament build still boots and gltfEntitiesNamed name table unchanged before/after re-export); produce the Diligent quickref in notes.md (exact .a + include dirs per platform, key API signatures from SampleBase/PBR/AssetLoader interfaces); capture baseline screenshots /tmp/shot_diligent_baseline_{menu,world,topdown,close}.jpg via ENGINE_SCREENSHOT + ENGINE_CAMERA through scripts/run.sh
result: Phase 0 prep complete (verifier PASS): GLB loads as-is in Diligent GLTFLoader (no re-export needed, -kn/-kv/-ke are keep flags), 4 baseline screenshots captured, Diligent quickref in notes.md

desc: Phase 1 core renderer: replace filament in c-engine/renderer/Renderer.cpp/.h and pch.h with Diligent Vulkan IRenderDevice/IDeviceContext, SDL3 XCB/HWND swapchain, world render pass (clear color {0.02,0.04,0.09,1.0}, color+DSV, resize via ResizeSwapChain), 60-degree fov projection struct, ReadPixelsFromBuffer JPEG for ENGINE_SCREENSHOT; ALSO replace filagui::ImGuiHelper in c-engine/gui/GuiManager.cpp with a no-op stub behind the existing guiIsActive() gate (c-game links libfilagui.a and it needs filament — required for an honest build) and port FlyingCamera.cpp off filament::math; update c-engine/CMakeLists.txt + c-game/CMakeLists.txt to link the Diligent static libs (build-linux / build-win layouts) and drop filament from the build enough to compile; acceptance: window with clear color, resize works, screenshot JPEG written

Phase 2 model pipeline: c-engine/gltf/Gltf.cpp/.h loads oghuzlands.glb (from pak) via DiligentTools GLTFLoader with ITextureLoader (route KTX2 through prebuilt ktx transcoder where needed); GLTF_PBR_Renderer bound to swapchain RT/DSV renders each frame with camera + sun + ambient IBL; UpdateAnimation replaces Animator; loader bounding-box option re-derives the Aabb for Game.cpp camera modes; build name->entity table so gltfEntitiesNamed keeps working; gltfDestroy release path; wire sun/ambient in c-game/game/Game.cpp

Phase 3 terrain splat shader: rewrite terrain.mat as HLSL (5 sampler2dArrays, int[100] tileLayer0..2, styleRemap, sand/snow height+fade, sun+ambient matching phase-2 lighting, v=1-u UV convention from probeUvOrientation); build-time glslang HLSL->SPIR-V CMake step replacing matc/.filamat artifact and updating the manifest 'material' field in scripts/build-terrain.py; c-engine/terrain/Terrain.cpp creates PSOs and splat SRB over GLTFLoader's vertex buffers; port KTX2/BC7 2D-array upload via Diligent CreateTexture from BC7 blocks; keep terrainApplyToAsset semantics

Phase 4 GUI: replace filagui ImGuiHelper in c-engine/gui/GuiManager.cpp/.h with thirdparty imgui + imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp compiled into c-engine (do NOT link libDiligent-Imgui.a); UI render pass after the world pass (same extent, blend on, no depth writes, skipped when !guiIsActive); keep guiScale/font behavior and feedInput; MainMenuGui/CreditsGui PNG upload via stb -> Diligent texture

Phase 5 cutover + validation: remove all filament include dirs/defines/libs from both CMakeLists (linux + win32 mingw cross with build-win/mingw-lib layouts per diligent/build.sh); update scripts/build.sh if it references filament artifacts; run plans/diligent-migration.md Phase 6 matrix on linux (menu boot, world+animation, topdown/close screenshots vs baselines, ENGINE_LOG_TIMEOUT clean teardown, resize); flag any visual/lighting deltas in notes.md

Dual-renderer follow-through (plans/dual-renderer.md superseded the in-place replacement of tasks 2-6; the split is implemented in-tree): fix remaining diligent-path defects found in visual validation vs filament baselines — (1) top-down camera renders blank on diligent, (2) screenshot readback has R/B channels swapped + sRGB backbuffer values (sky (85,56,40) vs expected dark blue), (3) Vulkan validation errors (2x VUID-VkImageMemoryBarrier-oldLayout-01212, VUID-vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer-srcImage-00186, 1 leaked VkSampler from GuiDiligent's static linearSampler), (4) washed-out close view. Then: re-shoot all 4 shots vs filament baselines, verify clean teardown + filament path regression, verify win32 mingw cross build
